Hi Sam / Michael

Quick answers to the questions + an initial integration estimate: 

1) SDK support
- Redwood provides first-class SDKs for Python and Node (official). Node SDK has full feature parity (streaming, function/tool-calling, structured output helpers). TypeScript types are included. Java and Go client libraries are planned (ETA Q3 2026).

2) Streaming & reconnection behaviour
- We support streaming via chunked HTTP + SSE (recommended) and a websocket option for high-throughput use cases.
- Latency typically 50-200ms per chunk depending on model & region; initial token latency is usually under 150ms on our shared hosted endpoints, and lower on Dedicated pools.
- We provide client-side helpers to resume streams and detect partial responses; for critical flows we recommend a small server-side aggregator to dedupe/resume.

3) Tool-calling & structured outputs
- Function/tool calling follows the JSON schema pattern (we return a structured JSON object with name + arguments). For structured outputs you can pass a JSON schema to the model and we'll enforce/validate at inference time and flag schema violations in our response metadata.

Estimated effort (rough):
- SDK integration (implementing calls, authentication, basic end-to-end): ~2-3 developer sprints (2-6 weeks depending on resourcing).
- Streaming tests + resilience: ~2 weeks (includes reliability testing with reconnection scenarios).
- Tool-calling schema design + stub implementations: ~1-2 weeks (collab with your product/infra).
- End-to-end QA/UAT: ~3 weeks.

Dependencies for a smooth integration:
- API key & access to a test environment (we can provide sandbox creds).
- Network egress / firewall rules (our IP ranges / VPC peering if using Private).
- Example prompt sets and expected outputs for schema validation & quality tests.

Redwood-side owners:
- Integration technical lead: Dev Patel (dev.patel@redwood.ai) day-to-day tech support, sample apps, and streaming tests.
- Product rollout & success: Stephanie Nguyen (stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai) MAP coordination and milestone tracking.

If Michael can confirm availability, we can schedule a 30-min tech kickoff on Tue Mar 9 (Dev + Michael + Marissa + Stephanie). I've attached a short integration-spec.md to give the Acme team more context on endpoints, auth, and example streaming usage.

Cheers,
Dev
